about.label: ABOUT ME
about.headline: Full-Stack Developer
about.bio: I am an Information Technology student at KMUTNB dedicated to building modern web applications, scalable systems, and interactive digital experiences. With a strong foundation in Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, I enjoy turning ideas into high-performance solutions. Throughout my journey, I have gained hands-on experience building database-driven applications, exploring backend architectures, and engineering IoT/Embedded systems (such as piezoelectric energy harvesting and smart devices).
